lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular blobs is observed posterior to the gill slits, with clusters aligned in approximately five to six horizontal rows along the lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, creating a visible grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the central flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with high-intensity highlights on the dorsal edge and shadows below.

other_distinctive_markers: A pale, elongated cylindrical object is attached to the ventral-lateral surface posterior to the base of the left pectoral fin.
